correctness.rationale: TARGET route (i) audited by independent reimplementation over Q (Fractions). Verified: free CDGA G=H^3 x exterior(e12,e13,e23) with D(e_ij)=diagonal class; L-relation differentials vanish and D(omega) lies in the degree-7 relation span (solved exactly), so D descends; D^2=0 on the full quotient Q and on S3-invariants F; Euler checks give chi(Q)=24 and chi(F)=4=24/6. Invariant cohomology recomputed: H^0=Q,H^2=Q^2,H^4=Q^3,H^6=Q^2,H^7=Q^2,H^9=Q^2,H^5=0. Named classes A1,A2,BUU,BUV,BVV are nonzero (not in incoming image). Pairwise products verified at free level: D(x)=BUU*A2 and D(y)=A2*BUV exactly with the artifact x,y; hence [a][b]=0=[b][c]. Massey representative m=BUU*y-x*BUV satisfies D(m)=0 at free level (stronger than mod-ideal) and its H^9 coordinates are (4,0)!=0 with image rank 0 in degree 9, so [m] is nonzero; mirror gives (-4,0). H^5=0 (FD5 rank 4 on 4-dim domain) makes indeterminacy BUU*H^5+H^5*BUV=0, so the Massey set is the singleton {(4,0)}. Transfer uses the standard facts: the Cohen-Taylor/Totaro/LS model is a rational CDGA model of the unordered configuration for the formal manifold S^2xS^2 (S3-invariants preserve quasi-isomorphisms in char 0), and triple Massey sets are preserved under CDGA quasi-isomorphisms, so nonzero Massey obstructs formality of every Sullivan model. Minor DRAFT typo in the displayed Euler sum signs (H^9 term) does not affect any computation.
